description: Use this when you need the full content of an item on the user's XcutAI canvas, by canvas id and item id (from xcut_get_canvas): a post or video's transcript and stats, a note, a chat's messages (paginate with `before`), a website's text, an analytics table, a Meta ad, or a group's contents. Free. Do not use to list a canvas (use xcut_get_canvas).
